plan: Sell SOXL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell MUU and METU to zero to further reduce leverage.
Trim SPY to 20% to cure the concentration breach and reduce broad index exposure.
Add to QQQI, targeting 15% of the book, to favor income and stability.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, leading to lower expected drawdowns. However, potential upside is also limited.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim MUU to 3% and METU to 2% to further reduce leverage.
Trim SPY to 25% to cure the concentration breach and align with balanced allocation.
Buy TSM, targeting 4% of the book, as a high-quality tech add from the scanner.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small leveraged component.
balanced.read: The balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality tech name. Expect moderate drawdowns with reasonable upside potential.

plan: Add to SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU, increasing leveraged ETF exposure to press what is working.
Trim SPY to 25% to cure the concentration breach while maintaining broad exposure.
Buy TSM and GEV, targeting 4% each, to add high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for ~4% monthly growth, stretching for higher returns. It significantly increases leveraged ETF exposure and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of substantially higher drawdown risk and the daily decay/rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETFs.
Sell CRWD and SNOW to zero to remove high-beta single names.
Trim SPY to 20% to cure the concentration breach and reduce broad index exposure.
Add significantly to QQQI, targeting 40% of the book, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield and minimizing drawdown.
income.read: The income plan targets ~1% monthly distributions, prioritizing yield and low drawdown. It drastically reduces growth-oriented and leveraged holdings. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
